title: Japanese stage path labels truncate ('Intermedi...', 'Upper int...', 'Advanced' on iPad) on the desk hero and the Checkpoints page
detail: The six stage headers of the stage path (Kana, Foundations, Bridge, Intermediate, Upper intermediate, Advanced) get equal narrow slots after the stones; the later stages' names are ellipsised. Mac desk: 'Intermediate' and 'Upper intermediate' 69px wide, ellipsised; iPad portrait: 'Intermediate', 'Upper intermediate' and 'Advanced' 52px; Checkpoints page mac: 'Upper interme...'. Only a hover title (absent on the touch devices) reveals the full name. A future stage holds 2 grid columns (one dashed stop), while a built stage's columns are its units + checkpoints (js/core/jaui.js:169-176), so each future stage label gets ~2/n of the width.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-desk-mac.png (hero bottom row), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-checkpoints-mac.png; DOM measure: ELLIP b 'Intermediate' 828,396 69x19, 'Upper intermediate' 933,396 69x19 (mac); 559,612 52x19 / 642,612 / 724,612 (ipad)
fix: Give the not-yet-built stages (which have no stones) a label-width minimum or let labels wrap to two lines; alternatively collapse the three future stages into one 'Later: Bridge → Advanced' group. jaui stage path in js/core/jaui.js.
rootCause: Stage label column width derived from the number of stones in the stage; empty future stages get the minimum slot

title: Mind path: Decisions and strategy units are numbered Y3.1/Y3.2/Y3.3 while every other unit is <path>.U<n>
detail: On #/mind/path every psychology/philosophy unit reads Y1.U1, Y2.U3, P1.U2..., but Y3's three units read Y3.1, Y3.2, Y3.3 — the same shape as a LESSON ref (F1.1). Once Y3 is released its lessons would be Y3.1.1 next to Y1.U1.1, and the bare 'Y3.1' looks like a lesson of a unit Y3 in search, chips and the spine.
evidence: js/data/mind.js:33 u("Y3.1",...), u("Y3.2",...), u("Y3.3",...) vs :31-32,34-36 '.U<n>'; docs/mind-plan.md:113-119 uses the same Y3.1 naming; screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-mind-path-mac.png
fix: Rename to Y3.U1–Y3.U3 in js/data/mind.js (nothing released references them yet) and the plan.

title: Japanese lesson inspector reads '0 of 1 sessions'
detail: On a Japanese Stage 1 lesson (e.g. #/ref/ja/1.1) the inspector's check 'Passed the practice' has the sub-line '0 of 1 sessions' — a hard-coded string with the wrong plural.
evidence: js/modules/jatopic.js:297 ev.practised ? "passed" : "0 of 1 sessions"; screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-1.1-mac.png (inspector, third check)
fix: 'not yet' (or '0 of 1 session'); the count is always one, so say 'one session' / 'not passed yet'.

title: Mind lesson inspector has no status selector, confidence (RAG) or progress bar, unlike every other study space
detail: On a Code, Japanese or Creatives lesson the inspector carries the shared status row (Not started · Started · Paused · Completed select), the R/A/G confidence picker and a percent bar (invariant 107: the status 'may still be set by hand, as in a subject'). A Mind lesson's inspector shows only 'STATUS 0 of 4 checks' and the four read-only checks: no way to mark a lesson Paused or set confidence, and no percentage, although the desk and spine count Mind lessons by that same shared status.
evidence: js/modules/mindtopic.js:361-386 ctx.status builds only the head and checkgrid; compare js/modules/jatopic.js:295-318, js/modules/crtopic.js:220-243, js/modules/codetopic.js:160-210 (status select + KOS.rag.picker). Screenshots /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-mind-F1.1-mac.png vs /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-1.1-mac.png
fix: Reuse the same status/RAG block (ideally hoist it into one shared helper used by all four topic modules, since it is copy-pasted three times) and add it to ctx.status in mindtopic.js.
rootCause: Each study space's topic module re-implements the inspector status block; Mind's copy omitted the row

title: Touch targets under 44px in Japanese and Mind: stage-path checkpoints 21px wide, Journal kind chips 32px tall, Daily-minutes slider 16px tall
detail: On iPad (portrait and landscape) and iPhone: (1) the stage path's checkpoint buttons (data-ui ja.path-checkpoint) are 21x44 — a thin target between unit squares, and they are the only way to open a checkpoint from the desk's path; (2) Mind Journal's kind filter chips (.k-mind-kindpick: All, Insight, Quote, Question, Position, Reflection) are 32px tall on touch; (3) Japanese settings' Daily minutes range input is 129x16.
evidence: DOM measure (pointer:coarse): ipadl ja.path-checkpoint '合' 305,641 21x44 and 3 more; iphone same at 68,548 21x44; ipadl/iphone button.k-mind-kindpick 'All · 9' 68x32 … 'Reflection · 2' 140x32; ja.daily-min 129x16 (ipad, iphone). css/views/mind.css:338 min-block-size: var(--hit) (32px) with no coarse override; css/components.css:677-684 raises only .k-btn/.k-seg-item/.k-menu-item/.k-rail-item/.k-iconbtn.
fix: Under (pointer: coarse) give .k-mind-kindpick min-block-size var(--hit-coarse); give .k-ja-cp an invisible-free hit area of 44px wide (pad the node, not a pseudo overlap — invariant 69) or make the circle 28px with 8px spacing within a 44px column; give .k-range a 44px tall track box on coarse pointers.
rootCause: Page-specific controls use --hit (32px) and are not in the shared coarse-pointer list
